checks.detail: A world edit does not teleport or reset the agent.

checks.detail: The agent eats and rests without an available bed.

checks.detail: The renewed request can be executed to its goal.

checks.detail: The run control enables automatic execution.

checks.detail: Update executes an action after the pacing interval.

checks.name: Pause prevents later ticks
checks.detail: The state stays fixed after another pacing interval.

checks.name: Re-enabling stays paused
checks.detail: Enabling the component does not resume unexpectedly.

checks.detail: Reset restores the initial agent state and leaves execution paused.

checks.name: Reset cancels pending execution
checks.detail: No old action commits after the reset.
